Although authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability, the existing authentication mechanism can be easily bypassed. The specific flaw exists within the EMC DPA Application service, which listens on TCP port 9002 by default. When parsing the orderby request parameter, the process does not properly validate a user-supplied string before using it to construct SQL queries.
